Callout.Name: House Fire - People Inside
Callout.Message: House fire with people reported inside.
Callout.Advisory: Two residents unaccounted for, smoke from the upper floor.

Script.Line: There is somebody in the back bedroom. My brother is in the back bedroom.
I could not get up the stairs. The smoke beat me back.
He is deaf. You need to know that before you go in, he is deaf.

Lines.Approach: Two of them unaccounted for and smoke coming out of the top floor. Get there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
